message.content: In one of the conversations, Li Hua expressed interest in creating a baby-friendly playlist by suggesting classic lullabies and gentle guitar melodies. Chae Song-hwa enthusiastically agreed, suggesting that including their band's mellow tunes could also be beneficial. Thus, it seems Li Hua and Chae Song-hwa are considering both lullabies and mellow, calming songs to create a playlist that could positively impact the development of babies.
